'''Paetram''' is a [[Kandori]] merchant visiting [[Tear]].{{ref/book|4|13}}

==Appearance==
He has wide shoulders, a big belly and a forked yellow beard. He wears an earring with a ruby the size of a pigeon's egg. Three silver chains looped across his chest indicate a Kandori master merchant.{{ref/book|4|13}}

==Activities==
He is in a tavern in the [[Maule]] discussing events with other patrons. When he mentions the [[Two Rivers]], [[Mat]] goes to his table to get details. He tells that [[Whitecloaks]] have entered the Two Rivers so his stash of [[tabac]] should go up in value since none of Two Rivers leaf will be available this year.

Paetram also tells Mat that the Whitecloaks in the Two Rivers are hunting the [[Dragon Reborn]], and are also after a [[Darkfriend]] with yellow eyes.{{ref|Referring to Perrin}} Mat presses for more information, and Paetram begins to get nervous; he offers Mat a free cask of Two Rivers leaf, as a gesture of honor and appreciation.

Mat tosses an Andoran gold crown on the table and tells them to buy themselves more drinks. As Mat walks away, he hears Paetram mutter to his companions that he had thought Mat was about to cut his throat, and a woman warns him not to try his ploys on that kind.{{ref/book|4|13}}
